description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.brd.

currentPreset.description: A length-delimited opaque byte string for the current side of the bridge.
currentPreset.title: Current preset payload
currentPreset.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it byte-for-byte unless the target side explicitly requires replacing the current preset.
currentPreset.x-meido-game-usage: The outer bridge only copies this blob; KCES and COM3D2_5 decode it through their own preset implementations.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The KCES export path writes GP03_BRIDGE, version 2001, the maid GUID, and two length-delimited preset blobs before emitting the .brd file.
The reverse bridge writes GP03_BRIDGE version 2000, the maid GUID, and an optional CRC preset blob before saving 0.brd.
The bridge reader checks GP03_BRIDGE, consumes the version and GUID, reads the two declared byte lengths, and sends the embedded legacy preset to the preset loader.

format.description: The MeidoSerialization marker for the GP03 bridge editing envelope.
format.title: Editing format marker
format.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep kces-gp03-bridge when using the JSON codec; the native writer emits only the binary bridge fields.
format.x-meido-game-usage: This marker belongs to the editing representation and is not written as a native game field.

guid.description: The string identifying the character transfer session.
guid.title: Character transfer GUID
guid.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it stable across the paired preset payloads and use a valid GUID generated by the game when creating a new bridge.
guid.x-meido-game-usage: The bridge reader consumes the GUID in the outer record; surrounding export/import paths use the same GUID in filenames and maid status.

legacyPreset.title: Legacy preset payload

legacyPreset.x-meido-game-usage: The outer bridge only copies this blob; its inner version and schema are handled by the receiving preset loader.

signature.description: The BinaryWriter string identifying a GP03 bridge file.
signature.title: Bridge signature
signature.x-meido-game-usage: The KCES and COM3D2_5 bridge readers require GP03_BRIDGE before consuming the remaining record.

trailingData.description: Bytes remaining after the two declared preset payloads.
trailingData.title: Bridge trailing bytes
trailingData.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep trailingData unchanged; do not treat it as another preset without source evidence.
trailingData.x-meido-game-usage: The reviewed game readers do not assign semantics to bytes beyond the current outer record.

version.description: The outer bridge generation: KCES writes 2001 and COM3D2_5 writes 2000 for the reverse direction.
version.title: Bridge version
version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the source value. Use 2001 for a new KCES-to-COM3D2_5 bridge and 2000 only when reproducing the reverse exporter.
version.x-meido-game-usage: The reader consumes this integer for the outer layout but the reviewed ImportPresetGP03 path does not branch on its value.
